video_title: Lakers Mailbag: The Ideal Center Next To Luka, Hidden Targets & More

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers need a center who can protect the rim and be an interior defensive force
quotes.excerpt: they need to be able to protect the rim, protect the paint, and be an interior force
quotes.quote: I want to prioritize three general things. First and foremost, they have to be a defender of a certain level. I have recently, and frankly throughout the season, talked about the limitations with DeAndre Ayton as a rim-protecting center. Whichever center the Lakers add, whether it is someone in free agency, whether it is someone they trade for, maybe it is someone they draft for, whoever it is, they need to be able to protect the rim, protect the paint, and be an interior force on the defensive end.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers need a center who is a better rebounder than DeAndre Ayton
quotes.excerpt: the Lakers need to also address the rebounding, the defensive rebounding
quotes.quote: The second thing would be rebounding. If we take the four teams that made the conference finals and just use them as a blueprint here, if you look at Karl-Anthony Towns, Chet Holmgren, Isaiah Hartenstein, Victor Wembanyama, and Jarrett Allen, DeAndre Ayton was a worse rebounder than all five of those players. So the Lakers need to also address the rebounding, the defensive rebounding. I think about that stretch at the beginning of the fourth quarter of Game 3 where the Lakers give up multiple offensive rebounds and they are in the thick of the game and they cannot get a defensive rebound to save their life.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers need a center who is a pick-and-roll partner for Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: the third and final thing is being a pick-and-roll partner with Luka Doncic
quotes.quote: The third and final thing is being a pick-and-roll partner with Luka Doncic. Ideally, that is a high-level lob threat. We have seen the success with Derrick Lively and Daniel Gafford, and then this past season with DeAndre Ayton and Jackson Hayes. If you have a big man who can figure out the tango with Luka, the one-two step, and get behind the defense and be a lob threat, be a presence at the rim, be someone who can catch the ball and finish and dunk, of course you would love to have a big who can be a lob threat.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers should target Derek Lively in a trade
quotes.excerpt: I would easily give up a first-round pick to go get Derek Lively
quotes.quote: I would easily give up a first-round pick to go get Derek Lively. I think he would be a great fit running it back with Luka in LA.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers should target Landry Shamet as a bench option
quotes.excerpt: Landry Shamet is an interesting bench option. I know he has not had a great finals
quotes.quote: If you go to New York, Landry Shamet is an interesting bench option. I know he has not had a great finals, but compare him to someone like Luke Kennard where he has had an awesome postseason shooting-wise, but has also been a point-of-attack defender and held his own in the backcourt defensively for New York, has closed a ton of games for the Knicks, was closing a ton of those games in the Cleveland series and the Eastern Conference finals. So I think he is someone that, for example, I would rather have than a Luke Kennard.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Keon Ellis is a potential minimum target for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I like Keon Ellis as a potential minimum candidate
quotes.quote: If you go to Cleveland, I like Keon Ellis as a potential minimum candidate or as a guy that is just a little bit above the minimum. I know Cleveland invested in him, but it did not quite work out during the playoff round with him. So he is someone I would be interested in.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Suggs and Wendell Carter Jr. are interesting trade targets
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Suggs is another name that if Orlando is in a situation where they feel they need
quotes.quote: Jalen Suggs is another name that if Orlando is in a situation where they feel they need to shed some salary, and it is not you are not going to dump Paulo Banchero or Franz Wagner, Desmond Bane is someone you just invested a lot of draft capital in, so I think once you get into that like Jalen Suggs, Wendell Carter Jr. territory, I would be interested in either one of those guys as a potential starter for the Lakers.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers should pursue Mikal Bridges if he becomes available
quotes.excerpt: I think Mikal Bridges would be someone who would be great to acquire
quotes.quote: I think Mikal Bridges would be someone who would be great to acquire. I do not think he is going to be available. I think Phoenix is going to try to run it back and build off of what they did last season.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Lauri Markkanen would be a great fit for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Lauri Markkanen is someone who I think would be a great fit next to Luka
quotes.quote: Lauri Markkanen is someone who I think would be a great fit next to Luka. I know Utah has plenty of guys, but he is someone I would be interested in.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Keegan Murray is a solid fit for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Keegan Murray, as Talk Franco mentioned earlier in the week, he is someone who I think
quotes.quote: Keegan Murray, as Talk Franco mentioned earlier in the week, he is someone who I think would be a solid fit.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Derek Jones Jr. and Kris Dunn are linked to the Lakers by fans
quotes.excerpt: the Clippers with Derek Jones Jr. and Kris Dunn, those guys have been linked to the Lakers
quotes.quote: And then there is the Clippers with Derek Jones Jr. and Kris Dunn, those guys have been linked to the Lakers by fans a lot, but have not officially been reported as guys that the Lakers have on their radar or guys that the Clippers have interest in necessarily trading or getting off of.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading for Nic Claxton and signing Robert Williams is a dream scenario
quotes.excerpt: I love this, I think this would be close to my dream scenario
quotes.quote: I love this, I think this would be close to my dream scenario in terms of what is actually realistic. Like, of course, if you can get a Walker Kessler, a Jalen Duren, a Derek Lively, if there is a way to pry Isaiah Hartenstein from OKC or Jared Allen, maybe, like there are some guys that I like a little bit more than Claxton. It has been a minute since we have seen Claxton in a competitive situation and his numbers have dipped a bit the last couple of years. But in terms of having a three-headed approach here with Claxton, Williams, and Hayes, all three elite lob threats and finishers, to your point, Claxton offers some versatility with his switchability and would allow the Lakers to have certain groupings that could switch one through five or two through five depending on who is out there.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Robert Williams is a perfect high-level backup center
quotes.excerpt: Robert Williams, I love as a backup, do not love him as a starter
quotes.quote: Robert Williams, I love as a backup, do not love him as a starter because, as you pointed out, he is not someone you can rely on to play 65 plus games or play into the high 20s. So if you are playing him 18 to 22 minutes a night as a high-level backup, I think that is a perfect role for him.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Jackson Hayes is a luxury as a third center
quotes.excerpt: Jackson Hayes to me is still between an every-night backup and a situational backup
quotes.quote: And Jackson Hayes to me is still between an every-night backup and a situational backup. And if you have him as a luxury as your third center, I think that would make sense and he has got the dynamic with Luka.

quotes.speaker: Jovan Buha
quotes.summary_phrase: Robert Williams' contract will likely be in the $10-13 million range
quotes.excerpt: it has been reported that he could be in that 12 to 13 million dollar range
quotes.quote: And then what is Robert Williams signing for? Because if you are trading for Claxton and signing Robert Williams, I think Robert Williams is going to make at least 10 million dollars if not, it has been reported that he could be in that 12 to 13 million dollar range. So for argument's sake, let us cut the Lakers a break here and say he signs for like 10 million dollars.
